Machine‑learning models predict a correction, as the price has breached the regression upper bound. Macro moving‑average supports (20‑week SMA, 10‑week SMA, lifetime TWAP, and VWAP) will be critical in determining whether the rally can sustain itself toward the cycle bull targets.
